source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΔΕΚΑΤΟΣ Περὶ τῶν αὐτῶν ἔτι, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἐν ἁγίᾳ σκηνῇ Ἀρά σοι σαφὴς, ὦ Παλλάδιε, καὶ ἀποχρῶν ὁ λόγος, ὃν ἐπὶ τῇ ἁγίᾳ σκηνῇ καὶ τῶν ἐν αὐτῇ πεποιήμεθα;
pass_a_gloss: Title: Concerning the worship (προσκύνησις) and service (λατρεία) in spirit and truth, Book (λόγος) Ten. Subtitle: Concerning the same things still, and concerning the things in the holy tent (σκηνή). [Cyril, unlabelled in PG:] Is the account (λόγος) clear (σαφής) to you, O Palladius, and sufficient (ἀποχρῶν), which we have made about the holy tent and the things in it?
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK TEN. Still on the same subjects, and on the things in the holy tent.
Cyril: Palladius, has the account we gave of the holy tent and of the things in it been clear to you, and enough?

apparatus.note: PG OCR; column may cut mid-sentence.

The opening question has no speaker siglum in PG; it is Cyril's, since he addresses Palladius, so the label 'Cyril:' is supplied. σκηνή of Moses is rendered 'tent' throughout Book 10, as in Books 3 and 9. No Scripture.
